s: I have to catch the bus right now, ______ I'll miss my brother's birthday party.【103年會考】
e: 我現在必須要去搭公車了，「否則」我會錯過我弟弟的生日派對。(Ａ)和(Ｂ)因為(Ｄ)直到。

s: I'm not sure if Kevin ______ this morning, but if he does, I'll tell him that you called.【103年會考】
e: 句中的第二個if是「如果」的意思，時態以現在式代替未來式。題幹則應該要填未來式，故選(Ａ)。

s: Jogging is the only exercise I enjoy.  I find ______ other kinds of exercise boring.【103年會考】
e: 慢跑是我唯一喜歡的運動。我覺得「全部」其他的運動都很無聊。(Ｂ)一些(Ｃ)很多(Ｄ)一些。

s: Smart Head, one of the hottest TV programs these days, ______ people free plane tickets to Hawaii if they can answer 20 questions correctly in 15 minutes.【103年會考】
e: 表現在的事實，用第三人稱現在簡單式回答即可，故選(Ｂ)。Smart Head，最近一個最熱門的電視節目之一，「給」人們免費去夏威夷的機票，如果他們在十五分鐘內，正確回答完二十個問題。

s:
Carson: Bye, girls. See you tomorrow, Phoebe.
Shirley: ______ did Carson say he would see you tomorrow?
Phoebe: We're going out for a picnic. Do you want to come?【103年會考】
e: Carson：掰掰。明天見，Phoebe。Shirley：「為什麼」Carson說他明天會見到妳？Phoebe：我們要去野餐。妳想來嗎？(Ａ)什麼(Ｂ)何時(Ｃ)哪裡。

s: Oliver ______ with joy when he saw his favorite band.  He kept saying loudly, “I love you guys!”【103年會考】
e: 當Oliver看到他最喜歡的樂團時，他開心的「大叫」。他持續的大聲說：『我愛你們！』(Ａ)等待(Ｃ)聽(Ｄ)同意。

s: Ms. Lee is a(n) ______ businesswoman.  Just now in her shop, she gave me back the wallet I left on the table last week.【103年會考】
e: 李女士是一位「誠實的」女商人。剛剛在她的商店時，她把我上週掉在桌上的皮夾還給我。(Ａ)有名的(Ｃ)重要的(Ｄ)聰明的。

s: Lexie ______ reading maps.  Even with a map, she still cannot find her way when she is in a foreign city.【103年會考】
e: have/has trouble＋V-ing... 表「有…的困難」，故選(Ｄ)。Lexie不擅長看地圖。即便有地圖，她在國外的城市還是找不到路。(Ａ)重視；在乎(Ｂ)擅長(Ｃ)有樂趣。

s: More and more cows on this farm are getting sick.  The problem is so ______ that the farm will be closed from tomorrow on.【103年會考】
e: 越來越多農場上的牛生病了。這個問題太「嚴重」了，以致於農場明天開始要關閉。(Ａ)重的(Ｂ)流行的(Ｄ)強壯的。

s: Some songs are forgotten very quickly.  A really good song can pass the test of ______ and be remembered for many, many years.【103年會考】
e: 有些歌曲會很快被遺忘。一首真正好的歌曲可以通過「時間」的考驗，而且會被記得很多很多年。(Ａ)知識(Ｂ)聲音(Ｄ)天氣。

s: I think the road ends here; it won't go any ______.  Shouldn't we turn back?【103年會考】
e: 我覺得這裡沒路了，不能再走「更遠」了。我們應該回頭嗎？(Ａ)比較靠近地(Ｃ)更快地(Ｄ)更長久地。

s:
Helen: Can you turn off the TV? I can't study with the ______.
Troy: You can just go back to your room so you won't hear it.【103年會考】
e: Helen：你可以關電視嗎？有「噪音」我沒辦法念書。Troy：妳可以回妳的房間，如此一來妳就不會聽到了。(Ｂ)熱氣(Ｃ)力量(Ｄ)燈。

p:
克漏字測驗


【103年會考】
e: 由其後兩句可得知，從1960年代到2007年人們對於肉類的需求量是「增加的」。(Ａ)掉落的(Ｂ)特別的(Ｄ)普通的。

p:
克漏字測驗


【103年會考】
o: we have changed our way of cooking meat
new kinds of meat have come on the market
there have been changes in the list of favorite meats
doctors have been worried that we eat too much meat
e: 由In the 1960s, beef was high on the menu.和In 2007, pork became the star. 可知在1960到2007的最受歡迎肉類，從牛肉變成了豬肉，故選(Ｃ)最喜歡的肉類清單已經改變。

p:
克漏字測驗


【103年會考】
o: where does the world's best meat come from
which country is the world's biggest meat maker
where can you eat the world's most delicious meat
which country uses up the most meat for each person
e:
由In 2007, each Luxembourger ate about 137kg of meat! 和 In 2007, each American ate about 126 kg! 可知「哪一個國家每個人吃了最多的肉」較符合文意，故選(Ｄ)。
中譯：你吃肉嗎？嗯…如果你吃肉的話，那麼我們接下來的新聞你可能會很感興趣。一個研究顯示，世界上對於肉類的需求增加了。在1960年代，全世界的人們吃了六千四百萬噸的肉類，每個人大概吃了二十一公斤。在2007年，這個數字提升到兩億六千八百萬噸，每個人大概四十公斤。同時，最喜歡的肉類清單也已經改變了。在1960年代，牛肉在菜單上是最多的。在被吃的肉類清單中，有百分之四十是牛肉。在2007年，豬肉變成了新的明星。幸虧近幾年來人們對於健康的擔憂，家禽類也變得很受歡迎，從百分之十二提高到百分之三十二。那哪個國家每個人使用最多的肉類呢？你正在猜是美國，對吧？答案是盧森堡！在2007年，每個盧森堡人吃了一百三十七公斤的肉！相較於盧森堡，第二名是美國。在2007年，每個美國人吃了一百二十六公斤。現在，別再提數字了。我正在播放一首歌《咖哩香腸》給你聽，這個歌手正在唱他最喜歡的肉類菜餚的同名歌曲。好好享受吧！

p: 【103年會考】
e: 作者提到因為有Hui-ting的陪伴，所以「現在」很喜歡搭公車。由此可推回第一段，他以前不喜歡搭公車。used to表「過去曾經」，故選(Ｃ)。

p: 【103年會考】
e: 文中提到作者坐在公車裡，當時即將要去跟朋友會面。對當時的作者來說，與朋友見面是還沒有發生的事，但是對於現在來說，整件事情屬於過去式，因此要使用am/is/are going to（未來式）的過去式was/were going to，故選(Ｂ)。

p: 【103年會考】
e: 文中作者提到他很驚訝，因為很久沒有見到他的老鄰居。「他很驚訝」是一件過去的事情。在過去之前很久沒看到老鄰居，用過去完成式had＋p.p.，故選(Ｄ)。

p: 【103年會考】
e:
文中提到作者自從遇到Hui-ting後，搭公車就變成一件開心的事了。所以從遇到Hui-ting開始，直到現在都是這樣。因此要用現在完成式have/has＋p.p.，故選(Ａ)。
中譯：
讀者故事
　　在夏天的尖峰時刻搭公車，從來不是一件舒服的事。我所有的朋友都很討厭這件事。而我呢？嗯…我以前也很討厭。
　　這個故事是發生在兩個月前。我在一臺塞滿了幾乎是整個城市裡所有人的公車裡。我跟一個朋友Neal相約要去看一場表演。然後他打電話來，說他不能來。「這並不是我計畫好的星期五。」我當時這樣想著。公車上的空氣很糟糕。在我前面的男人聞起來像一條死掉的魚。當我正在為自己哀悼時，一個女生叫了我的名字。我一開始沒有認出她來。然後，我很驚訝的發現她竟然就是老鄰居Hui-ting。我很多年沒看到Hui-ting了。當我們還是小孩子時，每天都玩在一起。我們很開心能看到彼此，所以我們決定要一起吃晚餐。而這是未來很多次晚餐的一個開端。
　　有Hui-ting的陪伴，搭乘公車已經變成我最愛的一件事。公車裡仍然塞滿了人，但是我仍然每天都很享受搭車的過程。
（Xiang Chang，臺北）

s: (１)Why did Angelica invite her friends?
p: 【103年會考】
e: 由The kids are planning to give a party at our new house.  I hope all of you can come.可推知是一場新家派對邀約，故選(Ａ)去看她的新家。

s: (２)Look at the map.  Where does Angelica live?
p: 【103年會考】
o: At .
e:
出了火車站直走，看到雞舍後過了橋，看到大樹後右轉，走到底，她們家在路的最尾端，故選(Ｄ)。
中譯：我親愛的朋友：
　　我和家人一個月前搬去鄉下的家了。小孩們計畫在我們的新家辦一個派對。我希望你們全部都能來。派對會在星期六早上的十一點，會有很多的食物和飲料。
　　信件裡附有我們家的地圖。在你們下火車後，走車站前面那條路。沿著路你們會看到一個雞舍。不要轉彎，一直走，直到看到一座橋。跨越橋後，你會看到左邊有一個大樹。經過大樹後右轉，然後走大概五分鐘。你會看到幾間房子。我家在路的最尾端，河的旁邊。

o: A new way of seeing the world.
How to be a comic writer.
A smart way to face work problems.
How to buy a book on the Internet.

王明達　著
原價450→特價199　現在就買吧！
http://www.mingdawangbooks.net/thewayout/

在我朋友家讀了幾頁後，我無法放下這本書。我借回去後，讀了一整夜。我認為它可以幫助害怕面對家庭問題的人。─Sam Lee
這本書拯救了我的生命。它開了一扇門，引導我進去一個真愛的世界。我能夠用一個嶄新的眼光面對周圍的世界。─Candy Vigor
這本書的第一部分真的讓我很感動，讓我想要繼續讀下去。然而，當我讀到第二部分時，覺得很無聊。事實上，我還沒有讀完這本書。─Rod Green
這本書幫助我忘了煩惱。對於書本裡的人物，我又哭又笑。這本書用簡單又清楚的言語寫成，任何年紀的人都能享受這本書。─Vivian Lu

s: (１)What can we learn about Eddie?
p:
Cecilia: Eddie's having a tasting party this Saturday.
Gloria: No!
Cecilia: And we're both invited.
Gloria: No! I told you I'd never go to any of his tasting parties again!
Cecilia: He said he wanted to share his newest cakes with his dearest friends.
Gloria: If he sees us as his dearest friends, he should stop having tasting parties!
Cecilia: Well, looks like baking really brings joy to his life.
Gloria: But it takes joy away from mine! Last time I was in bed for three days after his party.
Cecilia: If you hate it so much, you can just tell him.
Gloria: Why do I always have to be the bad person? Remember when I woke him up from his dream of making clothes? There was a lot of crying, and he wouldn't talk to me for a month. You do it this time.
Cecilia: I can't. How am I going to face him in our dancing classes if I tell him?
Gloria: So we still have to lie at his party again?
Cecilia: I'm afraid so.
【103年會考】
o: His friends think he is a great dancer.
He is taking baking classes with Cecilia.
His friends did not like the clothes he made.
He did not know how to say no to his friends.
e: 由對話中提及上次Eddie做衣服的夢想被Gloria打破了，可見他的朋友並不喜歡他做的衣服，故選(Ｃ)。

s: (２)Which is true?
p:
Cecilia: Eddie's having a tasting party this Saturday.
Gloria: No!
Cecilia: And we're both invited.
Gloria: No! I told you I'd never go to any of his tasting parties again!
Cecilia: He said he wanted to share his newest cakes with his dearest friends.
Gloria: If he sees us as his dearest friends, he should stop having tasting parties!
Cecilia: Well, looks like baking really brings joy to his life.
Gloria: But it takes joy away from mine! Last time I was in bed for three days after his party.
Cecilia: If you hate it so much, you can just tell him.
Gloria: Why do I always have to be the bad person? Remember when I woke him up from his dream of making clothes? There was a lot of crying, and he wouldn't talk to me for a month. You do it this time.
Cecilia: I can't. How am I going to face him in our dancing classes if I tell him?
Gloria: So we still have to lie at his party again?
Cecilia: I'm afraid so.
【103年會考】
o: Cecelia has not talked to Eddie for a month.
Cecelia had a good time at Eddie's last party.
Gloria shared Eddie's cakes with other friends.
Gloria does not want to go to Eddie's tasting party.
e: (Ａ)是Gloria和Eddie沒有說話一個月，而非Cecilia。(Ｂ)由文中看不出來Cecelia喜歡他上次的派對。(Ｃ)由文中看不出來Gloria有和其他朋友分享蛋糕。故選(Ｄ)Gloria不想要去參加Eddie的試吃派對。

s: (３)What does it mean?
p:
Cecilia: Eddie's having a tasting party this Saturday.
Gloria: No!
Cecilia: And we're both invited.
Gloria: No! I told you I'd never go to any of his tasting parties again!
Cecilia: He said he wanted to share his newest cakes with his dearest friends.
Gloria: If he sees us as his dearest friends, he should stop having tasting parties!
Cecilia: Well, looks like baking really brings joy to his life.
Gloria: But it takes joy away from mine! Last time I was in bed for three days after his party.
Cecilia: If you hate it so much, you can just tell him.
Gloria: Why do I always have to be the bad person? Remember when I woke him up from his dream of making clothes? There was a lot of crying, and he wouldn't talk to me for a month. You do it this time.
Cecilia: I can't. How am I going to face him in our dancing classes if I tell him?
Gloria: So we still have to lie at his party again?
Cecilia: I'm afraid so.
【103年會考】
o: Tell Eddie to stop telling lies.
Tell Eddie how to find joy in baking.
Tell Eddie to stop crying over small things.
e:
由上下文可知，在上次的試吃派對後，Gloria臥病三天，因此，她們兩個要告訴Eddie停止烘焙這件事情，故選(Ａ)。
中譯：Cecilia: 這個禮拜六Eddie要有個試吃派對耶！
Gloria: 不！
Cecilia: 而且我們兩個都被邀請了。
Gloria: 不！我告訴過你，我再也不要去參加他的任何試吃派對了。
Cecilia: 他說他想要和他最好的朋友分享最新的蛋糕。
Gloria: 如果他視我們為最好的朋友，他就應該停止邀請我們去他的試吃派對。
Cecilia: 嗯…看起來烘焙真的帶給他的生活很多樂趣。
Gloria: 但是它拿走我生活的樂趣。上次派對後的三天我都在病床上度過。
Cecilia: 如果你真的痛恨試吃派對，你就告訴他吧！
Gloria: 為什麼我每次都要當黑臉？記得那時，當我把他從做衣服的夢想中敲醒，他一直哭而且一個月都不跟我說話。這次換你了。
Cecilia: 我不能。如果我告訴他了，舞蹈課的時候，我要如何面對他？
Gloria: 所以這次我們在他的派對上，又要再一次說謊？
Cecilia: 恐怕是。

o: Nathan Lang's love and hate for his family.
The good and bad about Nathan Lang's movies.
The rise and fall of Nathan Lang in show business.
Nathan Lang's life before and after he became an actor.

s: (３)Here are reviews about Nathan Lang's movies. From the reading, which is most likely a review for Dreams?
p: 【103年會考】
e:
文中提到Nathan Lang的最後一部電影Dreams有得獎，但卻沒有幫他把以前的粉絲帶回電影院，表示票房不佳。(Ｃ)選項裡有提到「觀眾沒有再把他當成是Nathan Lang，而是電影裡的那個角色」代表他演得很好。(Ｃ)選項也提到「好的演技對票房沒有幫助」呼應了文章裡的描述，故選(Ｃ)。
中譯：
永遠的下臺一鞠躬
　　演員Nathan Lang，78歲，昨天晚上在家裡睡夢中過逝。Nathan Lang在1970年代開始他的演員生涯。他最有名的就是在Young Hours裡扮演Justin Maud。這部電影讓這個世界為他瘋狂。女人想要一個像他一樣的老公；男人想要一個像他一樣的兄弟。他的粉絲稱他為「永遠的Justin」。在Young Hours之後，Nathan Lang在幾部大片當中都有演出：Fallen、After tonight和Killing Jules。最後那一部讓他得到了最佳男演員的獎項。在1980年代，Nathan Lang在大螢幕上失去了他的光芒。在這段期間，他的電影從來沒有進入過前20名的排行榜。Nathan Lang的最後一部電影是Dreams。雖然這部電影讓他贏得兩個最佳男演員的獎項，卻也沒有把他的粉絲們帶回電影院。
　　這個星期六早上，在St. Peter's Church，將會舉辦一個如Lang所願的「電影派對」。他的朋友和家人們將會聚在一起再一次享受他帶給這個世界的美好年代。

s: (１)What do we know about the six people in the interview?
p:
Six people are being interviewed about the garden on the roof of their building.
Jasmine: I loved the idea when Wilber first told me about it. We had lots of meetings with our neighbors, trying to make them understand why it's good to build a garden on the roof. Now people love coming here, and it's helped many of us become friends!
Wilber: The whole thing wasn't easy at first. But Jasmine helped a lot. And she was really good at making people happy to give money for the roof garden.
David: My kids love going up there. They sit there watching butterflies and birds. The roof garden brings them closer to nature.
Samuel: You want something green? Visit the park! It's only one block away! After the roof garden was built, bugs started flying into my apartment! And the kids leave mud on the stairs when they come down from the roof!
Rosie: Our building is now cooler in the summer. My baby sleeps well even on hot summer days!
Flora: Guess where these tomatoes are from! Not from the supermarket. They're from our roof! Isn't that wonderful?

【103年會考】
o: They all said good things about the roof garden.
Some of them were paid to help build the roof garden.
They all talked about the roof garden before it was built.
Some of them worked on the plan to build the roof garden.
e: (Ａ)並非每一個人都提到屋頂花園的好處，Samuel有提到缺點。(Ｂ)文中提到許多人會捐錢來蓋屋頂花園，而不是被付錢來蓋屋頂花園。(Ｃ)他們是在蓋好之後才被訪問的，不是蓋好之前。(Ｄ)文中Jasmine有說Wilber首先提到這個想法，鄰居們也開了一些會議，所以有一些人是參與這個計畫的，故選(Ｄ)。

s: (３)What does the whole thing mean in the interview?
p:
Six people are being interviewed about the garden on the roof of their building.
Jasmine: I loved the idea when Wilber first told me about it. We had lots of meetings with our neighbors, trying to make them understand why it's good to build a garden on the roof. Now people love coming here, and it's helped many of us become friends!
Wilber: The whole thing wasn't easy at first. But Jasmine helped a lot. And she was really good at making people happy to give money for the roof garden.
David: My kids love going up there. They sit there watching butterflies and birds. The roof garden brings them closer to nature.
Samuel: You want something green? Visit the park! It's only one block away! After the roof garden was built, bugs started flying into my apartment! And the kids leave mud on the stairs when they come down from the roof!
Rosie: Our building is now cooler in the summer. My baby sleeps well even on hot summer days!
Flora: Guess where these tomatoes are from! Not from the supermarket. They're from our roof! Isn't that wonderful?

【103年會考】
o: Having meetings at the roof garden.
Taking care of the roof garden every day.
Having people agree to the idea of the roof garden.
Inviting people to make more use of the roof garden.
e:
Jasmine提到「這整件事情」不容易。後來有補充說明要讓他們了解在屋頂上蓋花園的好處，就可以知道「這整件事情」是在指「說服鄰居們同意蓋屋頂花園」，故選(Ｃ)。
中譯：有六個人正在受訪有關他們建築物屋頂上的花園。
Jasmine：當Wilber第一次告訴我這件事時，我就很喜歡這個想法了。我們跟我們的鄰居開了很多次會，試著讓他們了解為什麼在屋頂上蓋一個花園是好的。現在人們喜歡來這裡，如此一來幫助我們中的很多人變成朋友。
Wilber：整件事情一開始一點都不簡單。但是Jasmine幫了很多忙。而且她真的很擅長讓人們開心捐錢給屋頂花園。
David：我的孩子們很愛上去那裡。他們坐在那邊欣賞蝴蝶和鳥。屋頂花園把他們跟大自然的距離給拉近了。
Samuel：你想要一些綠色的東西嗎？參觀公園吧！它只有一個街區遠。在屋頂花園蓋好後，蟲開始飛進我的公寓裡。當孩子們從屋頂下來時，都把泥巴留在樓梯上了。
Rosie：現在我們這棟建築物在夏天時更涼爽了。我的小寶貝即使是在夏天，也可以睡得很好了。
Flora：猜猜看這些番茄從哪裡來的？不是從超市來的。它們來自於我們的屋頂！這不是很棒嗎？
